Verify pinout, thermal margin, and official manufacturer datasheets before production.

selection_checklist: Verify device class (opamp) and output stage (push-pull) — never substitute an uncompensated open-collector comparator for a push-pull op-amp without circuit redesign.
Confirm supply rail span (2.7–5.5 V rec, 5.5 V abs max) and exact SOT-23-5 pinout (1=IN_POS, 2=VEE, 3=IN_NEG, 4=OUT, 5=VCC).
Verify input common-mode headroom (Non-RR-In), output swing (RR-Out), and Vos (7 mV max) against signal chain budget.
Check closed-loop bandwidth (GBWP / Acl), full-power slew rate (SR / 2π·Vpeak), and capacitive-load phase margin on the bench.
